item.title: Redis Core Practice (Part 2): Five Core Data Types, MySQL Hot Cache, and Transaction Features
item.description: Part 2 of the Redis Core Practice series: In-depth analysis of global key lifecycle management (keys/scan/expire/ttl), hands-on practice with Strings, Hash, List, Set, and SortedSet data structures, real-world implementations including high-concurrency counters, WeChat comment streams, friend topology, and TopN leaderboards, importing MySQL 3308 multi-instance hot rows into Redis Hash via Linux pipes, and in-depth comparison between MySQL ACID transactions and Redis weak transactions with WATCH optimistic locking.
